title: Pol ni Vaato: why Ahmedabad's pols were built like mazes
concept: Explainer v2 (36 s, Sulafat). Reveal hook: 'Lost in a pol? That's the design.' One gate (pol = pratoli, gate), lane-lane-khadki maze, hidden passages for escape in raids, roof-to-roof messages, 2017 World Heritage City. Aim: comments naming your pol, shares to Amdavadi family.
